subject.title: Setup fails at wsl-create step: `Wsl/InstallDistro/0x800072f78` on Windows 26200 + WSL 2.7.3

question: Should setup support explicit adoption of a manually imported `OpenClawGateway` distro after direct WSL installation fails, or should it preserve that distro and direct the user to a separate supported recovery path?
rationale: Current code cannot distinguish a trusted setup-created distro from a user-imported one based on name and location alone; accepting it changes the provisioning trust boundary, while deleting it removes the only reported recovery route.

options.title: Add verified recovery adoption
options.body: Require deterministic freshness and lockdown validation plus explicit user confirmation before setup continues with an imported distro.

options.title: Preserve and guide manual recovery
options.body: Do not unregister an unproven existing target after a failed direct install; show an actionable recovery screen that keeps the manual distro intact.

recommendation.title: Add verified recovery adoption
recommendation.body: Require deterministic freshness and lockdown validation plus explicit user confirmation before setup continues with an imported distro.

likelyOwner.reason: The report concerns the repository's first-run WSL provisioning product boundary and needs a supported recovery-policy decision.
